tagline.en: San Diego to Alberta, through the Great Basin
tagline.zh: 从圣迭戈到艾伯塔，穿越大盆地

mileageSource: FHWA Route Log and Finder List, Table 1, January 2026

start.zh: 加利福尼亚州圣迭戈，与 I-5 相接

end.en: The Canadian border at Sweetgrass, Montana
end.zh: 蒙大拿州斯威特格拉斯，美加边境

en: I-15 runs from San Diego to the Alberta border, crossing six states and almost every kind of dry western country in the process: the coastal hills of San Diego County, the Mojave, the Las Vegas valley, the Virgin River Gorge, the Wasatch Front, the Snake River Plain, and finally the Continental Divide at Monida Pass and the plains of central Montana.

It carries two quite different roads under one number. Between Los Angeles and Las Vegas it is one of the most heavily used weekend corridors in the country, and through the Salt Lake urban area it is a wide urban freeway. Between those places, and for almost the whole of the Idaho and Montana sections, it is a two-directional line across empty ground, where the interchanges exist to serve a ranch road or a pass rather than a town.

Utah holds the longest state section and Montana is a close second, but the strangest piece belongs to Arizona. I-15 clips the state's north-west corner for less than thirty miles — a section cut off from the rest of Arizona by the Grand Canyon, expensive beyond all proportion to build, and of almost no use to the state that paid for it.
zh: I-15 自圣迭戈通往艾伯塔省边界，穿越六个州，沿途几乎囊括了美国西部所有类型的干旱地貌：圣迭戈县的滨海丘陵、莫哈韦沙漠、拉斯维加斯谷地、维尔京河峡谷、瓦萨奇山前、蛇河平原，最后是莫尼达山口的大陆分水岭与蒙大拿中部的平原。
同一个编号之下其实是两条截然不同的路。在洛杉矶与拉斯维加斯之间，它是全国使用最密集的周末走廊之一；穿过盐湖城都会区时，它是一条宽阔的城市快速路。而在这些地段之间，以及爱达荷与蒙大拿几乎全部路段，它只是一条穿越空旷土地的双向线路，立交的存在是为了接入一条牧场路或一处山口，而非一座城镇。
犹他州拥有最长的州内路段，蒙大拿紧随其后，但最奇特的一段属于亚利桑那。I-15 只在该州西北角擦过不到三十英里——这一段被大峡谷与亚利桑那其余地区隔开，建造成本高得离谱，而对出钱修它的那个州却几乎毫无用处。

en: Federal authorities insisted that I-15 pass through the Virgin River Gorge rather than take the cheaper route to the north that Arizona wanted, on the grounds of scenery and of easier grades for trucks. The canyon narrows to as little as 150 feet, there was no road at all through it, and the river had to be rechannelled repeatedly to make space for the carriageways.

Progress reflected the state's lack of enthusiasm. When federal highway funding was cut in 1966, Arizona stopped work altogether — the road was of no real benefit to Arizona, since it served traffic passing between Nevada and Utah. Utah, which had finished its own connecting section and badly needed the link to California, advanced part of its federal allocation to Arizona in 1969 simply to get the job done. Equipment had to be brought in from Texas to work the terrain.

The governors of Arizona and Utah dedicated the finished gorge on 14 December 1973. It cut eleven miles off the old route over Utah Hill, and it left Arizona owning seven major bridges in a place where it has almost no other reason to be.
zh: 联邦当局坚持让 I-15 穿越维尔京河峡谷，而不采用亚利桑那所希望的、成本更低的北侧线路，理由是风景更好、卡车爬坡更平缓。峡谷最窄处仅约 150 英尺，谷中原本根本没有道路，河道还必须反复改道才能腾出修建上下行车道的空间。
工程进度反映了该州缺乏热情。1966 年联邦公路资金被削减时，亚利桑那干脆停工——这条路服务的是内华达与犹他之间的过境交通，对亚利桑那并无实质好处。犹他已建成本州的衔接段，急需通往加州的连接，于是在 1969 年把自己的一部分联邦额度垫给亚利桑那，只为把工程做完。施工机械还得从德克萨斯运来才能应对这样的地形。
1973 年 12 月 14 日，亚利桑那与犹他两州州长为建成的峡谷段举行落成仪式。它比翻越犹他山的老路缩短了十一英里，也让亚利桑那在一个它几乎没有其他理由涉足的地方，拥有了七座大型桥梁。

en: The most expensive thing ever done to I-15 was not building it but rebuilding it. Between 1997 and 2001 Utah reconstructed sixteen miles of the road through Salt Lake City, adding general-purpose and high-occupancy lanes, rebuilding seven urban interchanges and three interstate junctions, and constructing or reconstructing more than 130 bridges.

The schedule was the point. More than half the traffic had to be diverted off I-15 during the work, and everything had to be finished before the 2002 Winter Olympics. Utah asked the Federal Highway Administration for permission to use design-build — then an experimental method for federal-aid highways — and the resulting contract was the largest single highway contract in the country at the time.

The federal Inspector General audited the project twice and found no issues that would affect cost, schedule or completion. Its accounting of how the estimate moved — from the original planning number, to the figure at contract award, to the final total once pre-award state spending was counted — is one of the clearest published records of what a megaproject of this kind actually costs.
zh: I-15 上花费最大的工程不是建造，而是重建。1997 至 2001 年间，犹他重建了穿越盐湖城的十六英里路段，增设普通车道与多乘员车道，改建七处城市立交与三处州际公路枢纽，并新建或重建了 130 座以上桥梁。
工期是关键所在。施工期间超过一半的车流必须从 I-15 分流出去，而全部工程必须在 2002 年冬奥会之前完成。犹他向联邦公路管理局申请采用设计—施工总承包——当时对联邦资助公路而言仍属试验性做法——由此签出的合同是当时全国金额最大的单项公路合同。
联邦监察长办公室对该项目审计过两次，未发现会影响造价、工期或完工的问题。它对估算演变过程的记录——从最初的规划数字，到合同签订时的金额，再到计入签约前州级支出后的最终总额——是公开资料中对此类大型工程真实造价最清晰的记载之一。

value.en: $2.528 billion — California $1.191 billion, Utah $621.1 million, Montana $401.7 million, Idaho $133.1 million, Nevada $127.1 million, Arizona $53.3 million. State and federal funds combined, in dollars of the day, as tabulated by FHWA at the close of the Interstate Construction programme; it excludes reconstruction after 1989.
value.zh: 25.28 亿美元——加利福尼亚 11.91 亿、犹他 6.211 亿、蒙大拿 4.017 亿、爱达荷 1.331 亿、内华达 1.271 亿、亚利桑那 5,330 万美元。州与联邦资金合计，按当年美元计，为联邦公路管理局在州际建设计划收尾时的统计口径；不含 1989 年以后的改建。

figures.source: FHWA, Interstate System engineering data, Part III – Cost: estimated cost of individual Interstate routes, 1991 Interstate Cost Estimate (data as of 31 December 1989)

label.zh: 最长与最短的州内路段

value.en: Utah, 405.71 miles, and Montana, 396.42; Arizona has just 29.48
value.zh: 犹他州 405.71 英里，蒙大拿州 396.42 英里；亚利桑那州仅 29.48 英里

figures.source: FHWA Route Log and Finder List, Table 1, January 2026

label.zh: 亚利桑那维尔京河峡谷段

value.en: More than $48 million for 29 miles of four-lane Interstate and seven bridges, about $1.63 million per mile; the contractor was paid $13.85 million for the roadbed and five bridges of the final 3.8 miles alone, built 1969–71
value.zh: 29 英里四车道州际公路及七座桥梁造价逾 4,800 万美元，约合每英里 163 万美元；仅最后 3.8 英里的路基与五座桥梁一项，承包商就获付 1,385 万美元，工期为 1969 至 1971 年

figures.source: Arizona DOT, "Trailblazers tested in building highway through remote gorge", ADOT Blog

why.en: The gorge is very widely described as having cost $10 million a mile and as being the most expensive rural Interstate ever built. That per-mile figure cannot be reconciled with the Arizona DOT's own accounting of about $1.63 million a mile, and no source gives a basis for it — it may be an inflation-adjusted restatement. No figure is given here because the two cannot both be right.
why.zh: 许多资料称这段峡谷造价为每英里一千万美元，并称其为史上造价最高的乡村州际公路。这一每英里数字无法与亚利桑那交通部自己记载的约每英里 163 万美元相互印证，且没有来源说明其计算依据——它可能是按通胀调整后的重述。此处不给出数字，因为两者不可能同时正确。

label.en: I-15 Corridor Reconstruction, Salt Lake City
label.zh: 盐湖城 I-15 走廊重建工程

value.en: $1.63 billion total — $448 million federal and $1.184 billion state and local — for 16.2 miles, more than 130 bridges, seven urban interchanges and three interstate junctions; construction April 1997 to July 2001
value.zh: 总投资 16.3 亿美元，其中联邦 4.48 亿美元、州与地方 11.84 亿美元；含 16.2 英里路段、130 座以上桥梁、七处城市立交与三处州际公路枢纽；工期 1997 年 4 月至 2001 年 7 月

figures.source: FHWA Center for Innovative Finance Support, I-15 Corridor Reconstruction project profile

label.en: How the Salt Lake estimate moved
label.zh: 盐湖城工程估算的变化

value.en: $1.36 billion planned in 1996; $1.59 billion when the design-build contract was awarded to Wasatch Constructors in March 1997; $1.632 billion once $41.6 million of pre-award state spending was counted
value.zh: 1996 年规划估算 13.6 亿美元；1997 年 3 月与 Wasatch Constructors 签订设计—施工总承包合同时为 15.9 亿美元；计入签约前 4,160 万美元州级支出后为 16.32 亿美元

figures.source: US DOT Office of Inspector General, audit report on the I-15 Reconstruction Project, 2001

trafficFigures.source: Arizona DOT, "Trailblazers tested in building highway through remote gorge", ADOT Blog

why.en: Six state agencies publish their own counts, and the range along this route is among the widest in the system — from an urban freeway in Salt Lake City and the Los Angeles–Las Vegas weekend corridor to sections of Montana where a day's traffic would not fill a single urban peak hour.
why.zh: 六个州的交通部门各自发布本州数据，而本路线的流量跨度在整个系统中位居最大之列——从盐湖城的城市快速路和洛杉矶—拉斯维加斯周末走廊，到蒙大拿某些路段（那里一整天的车流还填不满城市段的一个高峰小时）。

label.en: Virgin River Gorge, structures and access
label.zh: 维尔京河峡谷段的结构物与出入口

value.en: 29 miles carrying seven major bridges, with only three interchanges, none of which serves a community; ADOT has since rehabilitated all seven bridges and repaved the full 29 miles
value.zh: 29 英里路段承载七座大型桥梁，仅设三处立交，且无一服务于任何聚落；亚利桑那交通部此后已完成七座桥梁的修复并重铺了全部 29 英里路面

conditionFigures.source: Arizona DOT, "Trailblazers tested in building highway through remote gorge", ADOT Blog; Las Vegas Review-Journal, Road Warrior column

timeline.en: I-15 is numbered in the first Interstate numbering.
timeline.zh: 州际公路首次编号，I-15 获得编号。

timeline.en: The route is complete in southern Nevada from the California line to Sloan.
timeline.zh: 内华达州南部自加州州界至斯隆段建成。

timeline.en: Arizona halts all work in the Virgin River Gorge after federal highway funds are cut.
timeline.zh: 联邦公路资金削减后，亚利桑那全面停止维尔京河峡谷段施工。

timeline.en: Utah advances part of its own federal allocation to Arizona to restart the gorge work.
timeline.zh: 犹他将自身联邦额度的一部分垫付给亚利桑那，以重启峡谷段工程。

timeline.en: The Virgin River Gorge opens to traffic on 14 December.
timeline.zh: 维尔京河峡谷段于 12 月 14 日通车。

timeline.en: Montana finishes its last two-lane section south of Dillon, completing the route in that state.
timeline.zh: 蒙大拿完成迪隆以南最后一段双车道路面的改建，本州路线建成。

timeline.en: The final 14.5-mile link opens near Tremonton, Utah, on 20 November, completing I-15.
timeline.zh: 最后 14.5 英里路段于 11 月 20 日在犹他州特雷蒙顿附近通车，I-15 全线贯通。

timeline.en: The rebuilt I-15 through Salt Lake City is finished, ahead of the 2002 Winter Olympics.
timeline.zh: 穿越盐湖城的 I-15 重建完工，为 2002 年冬奥会做好准备。
